note: A template is a named bundle of realm roles. It defines the screens (home and menu), the API scopes the services allow, the record-visibility level (content: may open record content on their own device; titles_only: label, kind, date and source only; none: no record titles at all) and whether the role holds encryption keys. Applying a template changes the user's realm roles in Keycloak. The services enforce the scopes and visibility; hiding a screen is only a convenience. Service roles (svc_*) can never be assigned from a template. Adding a template needs no change in the screens beyond this registry.

scopes.referrals:create: Start a referral or a test request
scopes.referrals:read: See referral metadata (status, dates, who and where, reason)
scopes.records:titles: See record titles (label, kind, date, source)
scopes.records:content: Receive ciphertext and wrapped keys for one's own key, and upload one's own encrypted items
scopes.records:request: Send records requests under a granted consent
scopes.referral:send: Send an approved package to the receiving hospital
scopes.intake:manage: Take in referrals, link the patient, accept or deny, assign a doctor
scopes.ai:use: Ask the AI relay for suggestions (de-identified text, on request)
scopes.release:review: Review records requests this institution's policy holds for staff
scopes.orders:manage: Accept, schedule and report test and scan orders
scopes.keys:manage: Sign, revoke and rotate this hospital's keys
scopes.patient:self: A patient's own referrals, consents and copies

templates.name: Staff (referral coordinator)
templates.description: Handles the process only: asks the patient for consent, requests records, links the patient, sends the approved package, takes in incoming referrals and assigns a doctor. Sees record titles, never content (spec v4 D14).

templates.name: Doctor
templates.description: Requests referrals and tests, opens the records on their own device, chooses what goes in the package, enters the medicines, signs and approves the package, and reviews referrals sent to their department.

templates.name: Laboratory, radiology or ECG staff
templates.description: Confirms arriving patients, accepts or rejects test and scan orders, reports results, and reviews records requests the institution's policy holds for staff.

templates.name: Institution administrator
templates.description: Manages accounts and roles, signs and revokes doctors' keys, reviews records requests held for staff, and reads the audit log. No record content.

templates.name: Medicine-name reviewer
templates.description: Maintains the brand-to-ingredient mapping and sees the interaction data bundle. No patient records.

templates.name: Patient
templates.description: The patient's own app: their referrals, consent requests, and their own encrypted copy. Not assignable by institutions; patient accounts are created with a verified CNIC.
